name: mpmath-canonical
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is `mpmath`, a Python library for arbitrary-precision floating-point
arithmetic, with special functions, numerical calculus and matrices built on it.

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in this repository.
Everything in scope is mpmath's special-function, calculus and matrix subpackages: the code under mpmath/functions, mpmath/calculus and mpmath/matrices, together with their documentation: the function reference mpmath/function_docs.py, the pages under docs/functions and docs/calculus, docs/matrices.rst, and the module, class and function docstrings in those packages, including their examples.

Where the code and the documentation disagree about runtime behavior, the documentation is the
authority: change the implementation so that it does what the documentation says, and do not edit
or delete documentation to make a disagreement go away. The documentation is those pages, the
function reference texts in `mpmath/function_docs.py` (they become the docstrings of the public
functions) and the in-package docstrings, including their examples; in-package code comments are
only supporting evidence, and when a comment conflicts with the documentation, follow the
documentation.

Keep the public API stable and keep every behavior that already matches its documentation
working exactly as it does now.

Before you edit any code, write your research and your plan to /workdir/RESEARCH_AND_PLANNING.md. Cover what you learned about the existing co
